description_zh: 大阪烧，是一种日式蔬菜煎饼，为日本关西的一种民间美食，也是大阪饮食文化的一部分，面食文化的代表。由于外观的关系，也有人称大阪烧为“日本式比萨饼”。
tips_zh: 大阪烧的中的海鲜可以根据个人爱好放入。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡蛋打碎后搅匀，加入面粉和清水，放入鱿鱼丁和虾仁丁；
steps.content_en: Crack the eggs and mix well, add flour and water, add diced squid and shrimp;

steps.content_zh: 倒入包心菜丝、盐，用手抓匀；
最后加入培根片和少许油搅拌均即可；
steps.content_en: Finally add bacon slices and a little oil and mix well;

steps.content_zh: 不粘锅烧热后倒入一半的食材，用硅胶铲把边缘做成圆形，撒上适量黑胡椒粉；
5分钟后翻面，再煎5分钟即可；
抹上烧烤酱；
挤上蛋黄酱；
撒上葱花、木鱼花和海苔丝就能出锅了；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with chopped green onion, bonito flakes and shredded seaweed and serve;

steps.content_zh: 出锅后开始享用吧~
steps.content_en: Start enjoying after cooking~

description_zh: 习大大都爱的英国名菜，炸鱼薯条。
tips_zh:
1、冷冻的薯条超市就有的卖，带回家油炸一下即可。
2、油炸食物的时候不要离开电磁炉，不要让儿童靠近。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鳕鱼洗净后用厨房纸巾擦干水分后用盐和黑胡椒调味；
steps.content_en: Wash the cod, pat dry with kitchen towel and season with salt and black pepper;

steps.content_zh: 面粉中加入啤酒调成面糊；
steps.content_en: Add beer to flour to make a batter;

steps.content_zh: 烧1升油；
腌制好的鳕鱼先粘上干面粉，然后裹上面糊；
steps.content_en: The marinated cod is first coated with dry flour and then coated in batter;

steps.content_zh: 油烧热后放入锅中油炸到金黄；
steps.content_en: After the oil is hot, add it to the pan and fry until golden;

steps.content_zh: 炸好鱼后放入冷冻的薯条油炸到酥脆；
steps.content_en: After frying the fish, add frozen French fries and fry until crispy;

steps.content_zh: 洋葱和酸黄瓜切末；
放到蛋黄酱中搅拌后撒上黑胡椒粉再挤上一些柠檬汁，就是塔塔酱了；
steps.content_en: Stir in the mayonnaise, sprinkle with black pepper and squeeze in some lemon juice, and you have the tartar sauce;

steps.content_zh: 油炸好的鳕鱼和薯条站着塔塔酱，美味！
steps.content_en: Fried cod and chips with tartar sauce, delicious!

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧！
steps.content_en: Start enjoying!

name_en: Sweet and Sour Pork with Pineapple
description_zh: 人人都爱的菠萝咕噜肉，入口宜人。酸酸甜甜冲击味蕾，果香裹着肉香，口感丰富，味道浓郁！
tips_zh: 炸肉的时候一定要复炸一次才能酥脆。
tips_en: When frying meat, be sure to fry it again to make it crispy.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 里脊肉洗净去除筋膜，切小块，加入1个鸡蛋的蛋清、适量盐、2勺料酒抓匀，腌制20分钟；
steps.content_en: Wash the tenderloin, remove the fascia, cut into small pieces, add the egg white of 1 egg, an appropriate amount of salt, 2 tablespoons of cooking wine, stir well, and marinate for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 将半个凤梨的果肉挖出，切成小块，青红椒也切成小块;
steps.content_en: Scoop out the pulp of half a pineapple and cut it into small pieces, and cut the green and red pepper into small pieces;

steps.content_zh: 把腌好的里脊肉粘满生粉;
锅内加半锅油，热油7分钟后放入里脊块炸2分钟至表面微黄; 捞出后待油温上来后再复炸一次（2分钟），炸至表面金黄酥脆
steps.content_en: Add half a pot of oil to the pot, heat the oil for 7 minutes, add the tenderloin pieces and fry for 2 minutes until the surface is slightly brown; take it out, wait until the oil temperature comes up, and fry again (2 minutes) until the surface is golden and crispy

steps.content_zh: 锅内留底油，油热后放入番茄酱和糖，炒匀;
加入白醋、和50ml水，大火烧至略稠，加适量盐和鸡精调味;
steps.content_en: Add white vinegar and 50ml water, cook over high heat until slightly thickened, add appropriate amount of salt and chicken essence to taste;

steps.content_zh: 放入里脊肉、菠萝块、青红椒;
steps.content_en: Add tenderloin, pineapple chunks, and green and red pepper;

steps.content_zh: 挤上几滴柠檬汁;
翻炒均匀，出锅;
steps.content_en: Stir well and remove from the pan;

steps.content_zh: 装入菠萝皮中，开始享用吧。

description_zh: 家庭版酸辣粉，酸酸爽爽。非常适合一边吹空调一边大口大口的吃。
tips_zh: 粉丝不要煮太久，煮过了就失去了嚼劲。
tips_en: Don't cook the vermicelli for too long, otherwise it will lose its chewy texture.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 红薯粉丝提前用40℃的温水泡发；
酸豆角切丁、姜、蒜切末，香葱切碎；
steps.content_en: Dice the sour beans, mince the ginger and garlic, and chop the chives;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加适量油，预热后放入姜和蒜，炒出香味；
放入郫县豆瓣酱、炒出红油；
steps.content_en: Add Pixian bean paste and stir-fry until red oil is produced;

steps.content_zh: 放入肉馅炒散，炒变色；
steps.content_en: Add the meat filling and stir-fry until it changes color;

steps.content_zh: 加入足量的清水，大火烧开；放入泡好的粉丝，酸豆角，再煮5分钟；
steps.content_en: Add enough water and bring to a boil over high heat; add soaked vermicelli and pickled beans and cook for another 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 根据个人口味加适量生抽、鸡精、盐、藤椒油、陈醋、辣油调味即可；
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of light soy sauce, chicken essence, salt, cane pepper oil, mature vinegar, and chili oil to season according to personal taste;

steps.content_zh: 撒上香菜、酸豆角、酥黄豆，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Sprinkle with coriander, pickled beans, crispy soybeans, and enjoy.

description_zh: 洋芋擦擦”，就是用一种特制的工具——擦子，把削皮洗净的洋芋在上面擦成条状，用水淘过之后沥干，撒上适量的干面粉、食盐、葱花、佐料料等拌匀，然后放到煎锅里烙熟均可。
tips_zh: 吃的时候可以拌上油辣子、香醋一起吃，味道更佳。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 土豆洗净，去皮，用擦板擦成土豆丝；
steps.content_en: Wash the potatoes, peel them, and grate them into shreds with a grater;

steps.content_zh: 擦好的土豆丝放进水中洗掉多余淀粉并沥干水份；
steps.content_en: Put the grated potato shreds into water to wash off excess starch and drain the water;

steps.content_zh: 葱和蒜切末；
steps.content_en: Mince onion and garlic;

steps.content_zh: 切好的葱蒜末加入土豆丝中，同时加入面粉；
steps.content_en: Add minced onions and garlic to the shredded potatoes, and add flour at the same time;

steps.content_zh: 加入鸡蛋、盐、花椒粉、香油；
steps.content_en: Add eggs, salt, peppercorns, and sesame oil;

steps.content_zh: 搅拌均匀；
steps.content_en: Stir evenly;

steps.content_zh: 取一个干净的不粘锅，启动烹饪模式锅热后淋上适量的油后放入适量的土豆丝，将其摊成饼；
盖上锅盖焖3分钟；
steps.content_en: Cover the pot and simmer for 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 翻面，再煎3分钟；
steps.content_en: Turn over and fry for another 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 取出切成角；
开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 红三剁是云南家常菜，一到夏天，几乎家家的饭桌上都能看到。所谓红三剁，就是把三红：西红柿、新鲜红猪肉、和红辣椒分别剁碎，再一同混炒，非常下饭。
tips_zh:
1、因为红辣椒的皮比较老，所以会放一些青辣椒代替。
2、主要要选择有肥有瘦的五花肉。
3、减肥健身的同学可以选择牛肉碎代替猪肉。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 青尖椒剁碎；
steps.content_en: Chop green pepper;

steps.content_zh: 红椒剁碎；
在番茄的表面划十字刀；
steps.content_en: Make cross cuts on the surface of the tomatoes;

steps.content_zh: 用开水烫一下，去皮；
steps.content_en: Blanch it in boiling water and peel;

steps.content_zh: 番茄剁碎，大葱、大蒜、生姜也切末；
steps.content_en: Chop tomatoes, mince green onions, garlic, and ginger;

steps.content_zh: 锅烧热，放入油烧热后放入一半的葱姜蒜爆香；
下猪肉末翻炒均匀；
steps.content_en: Add minced pork and stir-fry evenly;

steps.content_zh: 倒入料酒，炒香、熬出猪油后盛出待用；
不用洗过，倒入剩下的葱姜蒜末，爆香；
steps.content_en: Without washing, add the remaining onions, ginger and garlic and saute until fragrant;

steps.content_zh: 倒入番茄丁；
翻炒出汁水；
steps.content_en: stir-fry to release the juice;

steps.content_zh: 下青红椒丁，翻炒；
steps.content_en: Add diced green and red pepper and stir-fry;

steps.content_zh: 下肉末，翻炒用盐和生抽调味后淋上一些水淀粉即可出锅了；
steps.content_en: Add the minced meat, stir-fry, season with salt and light soy sauce, then pour in some water starch and serve;

steps.content_zh: 盛一碗饭，拌入一些红叁剁，可以说非常下饭了。
steps.content_en: Pour a bowl of rice into it and mix in some red sambal. It can be said to be a great meal.

description_zh: 海南鸡饭和海南没有一点关系，它是新加坡国菜，随着时间的流转海南鸡已经在世界各地开花结果。无论在什么地方，来自原产地的香料都是不可或缺的材料。区别于普通的白斩鸡，海加坡在此道菜式上有得天独厚的优势——地处南海关口，上承海南做鸡之艺术，下受东南亚香米和香料。海南鸡饭吃的就在于一个鸡肉与香料的交融，而其他几种有如白切鸡，吃的是鸡的自然本味。因为新加坡无法吃到现杀的鸡，在口感和味觉上已经先输一筹，所以只能拼一个腌鸡的卤水，靠调料来弥补食材的不足。好的卤水是立业之根本，要想成事全靠卤，但这也只是革命的第一
tips_zh:
1、鸡要选择嫩一点的三黄鸡不要买成老公鸡、老母鸡了。
2、鸡油饭制作方法，搜索电饭煲食谱鸡油饭。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 香茅剥去外壳拍松、南姜切片、红葱切开后放入锅中加入香叶和足量的清水，启动烹饪模式；
steps.content_en: Peel and fluff the lemongrass shell, slice the galangal, cut the shallots and add the bay leaves and enough water to the pot to start the cooking mode;

steps.content_zh: 大火煮沸，煮出香料的味道；
steps.content_en: Bring to a boil over high heat to bring out the flavor of the spices;

steps.content_zh: 约10分钟后水沸腾，手提着鸡的头部，放到水中拎起，重复三次；
steps.content_en: After about 10 minutes, the water will boil. Hold the chicken's head in the water and lift it up. Repeat three times;

steps.content_zh: 将整只鸡泡在水中，盖上盖子，火力调整到最小，浸泡20分钟；
steps.content_en: Soak the whole chicken in water, cover it, adjust the heat to minimum, and soak for 20 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 20分钟后准备一盆冰水，捞出鸡浸泡在冰水中让鸡皮变得弹嫩，冷却后捞出挂起来，滤干水分（浸泡的时候开始做鸡油饭，用煮鸡肉的鸡汤来煮米饭）；
steps.content_en: After 20 minutes, prepare a basin of ice water, take out the chicken and soak it in the ice water to make the chicken skin elastic and tender. After cooling, take it out and hang it up, and drain the water (while soaking, start making chicken oil rice, and use the chicken broth used to cook the chicken to cook the rice);

steps.content_zh:
鸡油饭做好后鸡也冷却、滤干了，切块装盘，配上一碗鸡油饭。
蘸料分别是：甜酱油、姜蓉和鲜辣椒酱。

name_en: Stir-fried Shredded Pork with Garlic Moss
description_zh: 爽脆碧绿的蒜苔，颇受大家的喜爱。蒜苔炒肉丝可说是很下饭的家常菜了，只需要几分钟就可以完成。
tips_zh:
1、喜欢吃辣的可以放一些辣椒。
2、放了黄豆酱和蚝油就不要放盐了。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 蒜苔洗净切段
steps.content_en: Wash and cut garlic into sections

steps.content_zh: 猪肉切丝加1勺淀粉、1勺料酒、1克盐和1勺清油朝着一个方向搅拌上浆；
将黄豆酱、蚝油、生抽、2勺料酒调成酱汁；
steps.content_en: Mix soybean paste, oyster sauce, light soy sauce, and 2 tablespoons of cooking wine into a sauce;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加少量油热锅热油30秒后放入肉丝炒1分钟后盛出；
steps.content_en: Add a small amount of oil to the pot, heat the oil for 30 seconds, add the shredded pork and fry for 1 minute, then remove;

steps.content_zh: 锅中继续放少许油，烧热后放入蒜苔炒2分钟后倒入蒜苔和酱汁，大火炒1分钟即可；
steps.content_en: Continue to put a little oil in the pot, heat it up, add the garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes, then add the garlic and sauce, stir-fry over high heat for 1 minute;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 香香辣辣的鸡块搭配各种清爽的蔬菜还有腐竹，十分下饭。
description_en: The spicy chicken nuggets are paired with a variety of refreshing vegetables and beancurd sticks, which goes very well with rice.
tips_zh: 鸡肉要一点的童子鸡或者三黄鸡。
tips_en: The chicken should be a little chicken or three-yellow chicken.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 三黄鸡洗净切块备用；
steps.content_en: Wash and cut the three-yellow chicken into cubes; set aside;

steps.content_zh: 黄瓜和芹菜切段，姜切片，大蒜用刀拍一下；
steps.content_en: Cut the cucumber and celery into sections, slice the ginger, and pat the garlic with a knife;

steps.content_zh: 取一个干净无水的锅，启动电磁炉热锅1分钟，倒入油烧热，放入姜、蒜、八角、花椒炒30秒，煸炒出出香味；
放入剁好的鸡块，不断翻炒3分钟至变色；
steps.content_en: Add the chopped chicken pieces and stir-fry for 3 minutes until it changes color;

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、火锅底料和料酒，盖上锅盖焖5分钟；
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, hot pot base ingredients and cooking wine, cover the pot and simmer for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 放入黄瓜和腐竹并翻炒均匀后再焖5分钟；
steps.content_en: Add cucumber and yuba and stir-fry evenly, then simmer for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 放入芹菜，翻炒1分钟，均匀并根据个人口味加适量鸡精调味；
steps.content_en: Add the celery, stir-fry for 1 minute, and season with appropriate amount of chicken essence according to personal taste;

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Start enjoying.

description_zh: 手掌长的黑虎虾，煎到两面金黄色。熬上一些鲜艳、明亮的番茄汁，让大虾在里面煮上一小会，入口先是强烈的酸甜味，然后是鲜、香。虾仁的肉质紧实有弹性，一个人简直可以吃一盘。
tips_zh:
1、番茄味形的菜肴，入口要有强烈的酸甜味。
2、预算有限的话可以使用普通的草虾。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 黑虎虾洗净，减去虾须；
steps.content_en: Wash the black tiger shrimp and remove the shrimp whiskers;

steps.content_zh: 开背；
steps.content_en: open back;

steps.content_zh: 抽掉虾线；
淋上料酒、撒上盐腌制10分钟；
steps.content_en: Pour in cooking wine, sprinkle with salt and marinate for 10 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 取一个干净无水的锅，放到电磁炉上启动烹饪模式，热锅30秒后倒入30毫升油，放入虾煎2分钟；
翻面继续煎两分钟；
steps.content_en: Flip and continue frying for two minutes;

steps.content_zh: 取出洗好的虾，盛出；
锅中加入葱姜蒜末，炒20秒；
steps.content_en: Add the minced onion, ginger and garlic to the pot and stir-fry for 20 seconds;

steps.content_zh: 加入番茄酱、清水、白糖和大虾熬一分钟后勾芡，淋上白醋即可；
steps.content_en: Add tomato paste, water, sugar and prawns and simmer for one minute to thicken, then pour in white vinegar;

steps.content_zh: 装盘，开始享用吧。

description_zh: 螃蟹蟹豆腐煲是宁波的地标级美食，口感非常讨好儿！梭子蟹肉多，脂膏肥满，味鲜美，搭配豆腐烧制出一锅营养丰富又极其鲜美的煲汤，每一口都很满足。
tips_zh: 品质好的梭子蟹，壳呈褐色或紫色，纹理清晰有光泽，蟹足和躯体连接紧密，提起蟹体时蟹足不松弛下垂。
tips_en: Good-quality swimming crabs have brown or purple shells with clear and shiny textures. The crab legs are closely connected to the body, and the legs do not sag when the crab body is lifted.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 螃蟹洗净，开盖去腮，一个切成2半；
露出蟹肉的地方粘上淀粉；
锅内加适量油，预热后放入螃蟹，露肉的地方朝下；
煎至发黄变色即可；
盛出待用；
steps.content_en: Serve out for later use;

steps.content_zh: 土豆和豆腐切成块，姜切片，香葱切丝；
steps.content_en: Cut potatoes and tofu into cubes, slice ginger, and shred chives;

steps.content_zh: 锅内加半锅水，烧开后放入姜和土豆煮5分钟；
steps.content_en: Add half a pot of water to the pot, bring to a boil, add ginger and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 下入豆腐和螃蟹，并加入1勺料酒，盖上锅盖焖3分钟；
steps.content_en: Add tofu and crabs, add 1 tablespoon of cooking wine, cover the pot and simmer for 3 minutes;

steps.content_zh: 开盖加入少量水淀粉勾芡；
steps.content_en: Open the lid and add a small amount of water starch to thicken;

steps.content_zh: 加适量盐和胡椒粉调味，最后撒上葱丝，开始享用吧。
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of salt and pepper to taste, sprinkle with green onions and enjoy.

description_zh: 厌倦了水煮鸡胸肉、干巴巴的煎鸡胸肉，可以尝试一下番茄芝士味的鸡胸。
tips_zh: 鸡胸肉也可以换成去骨的鸡腿肉。
tips_en: The chicken breasts can also be replaced with boneless chicken thighs.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料；
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients;

steps.content_zh: 鸡胸肉洗净后从中间片开，撒上盐和黑胡椒腌制；
steps.content_en: Wash the chicken breasts, slice them in the middle, and sprinkle with salt and black pepper to marinate;

steps.content_zh: 小番茄洗净从中间切开；
steps.content_en: Wash the small tomatoes and cut them in the middle;

steps.content_zh: 锅烧热倒入橄榄油，放入腌制好的鸡胸肉；
每面煎3分钟左右，煎到金黄色取出；
steps.content_en: Fry each side for about 3 minutes until golden brown and take out;

steps.content_zh: 倒入黑醋和蒜末炒香后加入番茄、牛至和罗勒；
steps.content_en: Pour in balsamic vinegar and minced garlic and saute until fragrant, then add tomatoes, oregano and basil;

steps.content_zh: 熬3分钟出汁；
放入鸡胸肉，让汁水充分覆盖鸡胸；
steps.content_en: Add chicken breasts so that the juices fully cover the chicken breasts;

steps.content_zh: 在每个鸡胸肉上撒上芝士，盖上盖子焖3分钟将芝士融化；
steps.content_en: Sprinkle cheese on each chicken breast, cover and simmer for 3 minutes to melt the cheese;

steps.content_zh: 完成。

description_zh: 逢年过节怎么能少了这道四喜丸子呢，团团圆圆好寓意。肉丸中加入荸荠和香菇各种香味混合，口感层次非常丰富。
tips_zh: 猪肉要选择肥瘦相间的，瘦肉不要剁成肉泥，肥肉切的不要过细。否则，口感都不好。

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 干香菇提前加水泡发
steps.content_en: Soak dried mushrooms in water in advance

steps.content_zh: 马蹄拍碎，块不用太小，香菇、大葱、姜都切成末
steps.content_en: Crush the water chestnuts into pieces. The pieces don’t need to be too small. Cut the mushrooms, green onions, and ginger into fine pieces.

steps.content_zh: 肉馅中加入切好的马蹄、香菇、葱末、姜末和面包屑
steps.content_en: Add chopped water chestnuts, shiitake mushrooms, minced green onions, minced ginger and bread crumbs to the meat filling

steps.content_zh:
加入盐、鸡精、胡椒粉、香油、料酒、蚝油、生抽
向同一方向搅拌，搅拌上劲后取一团馅料，摔打成肉丸
锅内加半锅油，油热后下入丸子，炸至上色，炸的时候要隔一会儿翻动一下丸子，使其受热均匀
steps.content_en: Add half a pot of oil to the pot. When the oil is hot, add the meatballs and fry until they turn color. When frying, turn the meatballs every once in a while to make them evenly heated.

steps.content_zh: 炸好的丸子放入蒸锅，蒸20分
steps.content_en: Put the fried meatballs into the steamer and steam for 20 minutes

steps.content_zh: 蒸出的汤汁，倒入炒锅，加一点水，再加耗油、生抽，烧开后加水淀粉调制成酱汁，关火后加适量鸡精和香油调味
steps.content_en: Pour the steamed soup into the wok, add a little water, add oil and light soy sauce, bring it to a boil, add water starch to make a sauce, turn off the heat and add an appropriate amount of chicken essence and sesame oil for seasoning.

steps.content_zh: 将酱汁浇到丸子上即可。
steps.content_en: Pour the sauce over the meatballs.

description_zh: 大虾油而不腻 淡淡的番茄味配以虾的鲜香，乃下饭神器
description_en: The prawns are oily but not greasy. The light tomato flavor combined with the fresh aroma of the shrimps is a great addition to rice.
tips_zh: 大火烹虾 小火收汁更入味
tips_en: Cook shrimps over high heat and reduce the juice over low heat for more flavor

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 大虾开背去虾线
steps.content_en: Open the back of the large shrimp and remove the shrimp line

steps.content_zh: 葱姜切末备用
steps.content_en: Chop green onion and ginger and set aside

steps.content_zh: 启动电磁炉，锅内加油，开始预热
steps.content_en: Start the induction cooker, add oil to the pot, and start preheating

steps.content_zh: 放入大虾煎至变红起酥，盛出
steps.content_en: Add the prawns and fry until they turn red and crispy, then serve out

steps.content_zh: 锅中留底油，放入葱、姜末和番茄酱,炒出香味
steps.content_en: Leave oil in the pot, add onion, ginger and tomato paste, stir-fry until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 加入料酒、白糖、盐和生抽调味
steps.content_en: Add cooking wine, sugar, salt and light soy sauce to taste

steps.content_zh: 放入大虾，翻炒均匀
steps.content_en: Add the prawns and stir-fry evenly

steps.content_zh: 盖上锅盖，开焖
steps.content_en: Cover the pot and start simmering

steps.content_zh: 揭开锅盖，翻炒收汁
steps.content_en: Uncover the pot and stir-fry to reduce the juice

steps.content_zh: 出锅装盘
steps.content_en: Remove from pot and plate

description_zh: 鲜香绵嫩、回味悠长的肉食者大餐，加上丰富的配菜，开启愉悦的味蕾之旅
description_en: A meat-eater's feast that is fresh, tender, and has a long aftertaste, plus rich side dishes, starting a pleasant journey of taste buds
tips_zh: 随时关注锅内水分，避免烧干

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 翅表面划开，用盐、胡椒粉、辣椒粉腌制20分钟
steps.content_en: Slice the surface of the wings and marinate them with salt, pepper and chili powder for 20 minutes

steps.content_zh: 鲜虾去须，去虾线
steps.content_en: Remove whiskers and devein from fresh shrimps

steps.content_zh: 大蒜去皮，土豆、红薯切滚刀块，彩椒、洋葱和西芹切块备用
steps.content_en: Peel the garlic, cut the potatoes and sweet potatoes into cubes, and cut the bell peppers, onions and celery into cubes and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 将番茄酱、耗油、黄豆酱、生抽、淀粉调成酱汁
steps.content_en: Mix tomato sauce, oil, soybean paste, light soy sauce and starch into a sauce

steps.content_zh: 锅内加油，将含水量多的蔬菜铺在底部
steps.content_en: Add oil to the pot and place vegetables with high water content on the bottom

steps.content_zh: 放入大蒜、红薯和土豆，然后放上鸡翅
steps.content_en: Add garlic, sweet potatoes and potatoes, then top with chicken wings

steps.content_zh: 盖上锅盖，开始焖煮
steps.content_en: Cover the pot and start simmering

steps.content_zh: 放入虾，并淋上酱汁，盖上锅盖，继续焖煮
steps.content_en: Add the shrimp, pour over the sauce, cover the pot and continue to simmer

steps.content_zh: 三汁焖锅完成

description_zh: 好吃到连汤汁都不剩的美味鸡肉，肉质鲜嫩，绝对的米饭杀手，学会它再也不用出去吃啦
tips_zh: 黄焖鸡讲求一个焖，火候的掌握十分重要，汁一定不要收的太干，汤汁拌米饭才是最好的
tips_en: Braised chicken requires one stew, and the control of the heat is very important. The juice must not be too dry. It is best to mix the soup with rice.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 姜切片，青椒切块，芹菜切段，鸡肉切小块
锅内加水，启动电磁炉，放入鸡肉、姜片和料酒焯水，捞出晾干备用
steps.content_en: Add water to the pot, start the induction cooker, add chicken, ginger slices and cooking wine to blanch, take out and dry for later use

steps.content_zh: 锅内加入食用油，放入冰糖炒化
steps.content_en: Add cooking oil to the pot and stir-fry the rock sugar

steps.content_zh: 倒入鸡肉翻炒上色
steps.content_en: Add chicken and stir-fry until browned

steps.content_zh: 加入生抽、 耗油、黄豆酱、姜、蒜 ，翻炒均匀
steps.content_en: Add light soy sauce, oil, soybean paste, ginger, garlic and stir-fry evenly

steps.content_zh: 加清水没过食材，盖上锅盖闷煮
steps.content_en: Add water to cover the ingredients, cover the pot and simmer

steps.content_zh: 打开锅盖加入香菇、土豆然后盖上锅盖继续炖煮
最后放入芹菜段、干辣椒、青椒，盐、胡椒粉，翻炒收汁
steps.content_en: Finally, add celery segments, dried chili peppers, green peppers, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry to reduce the juice.

steps.content_zh: 黄焖鸡做好了
steps.content_en: Braised chicken is ready

description_zh: 经久不衰的下饭菜，酸酸辣辣，常驻你的开胃榜单
description_en: The timeless dish, sour, spicy and spicy, will always be on your appetizer list
tips_zh: 咸淡在出锅之前都调整，不能吃辣的可以减少黄灯笼辣椒酱的放入量
tips_en: Adjust the saltiness before serving. If you can't eat spicy food, you can reduce the amount of Huanglantern chili sauce.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 大蒜切末，小米椒切圈备用
steps.content_en: Mince garlic, cut millet and pepper into rings and set aside

steps.content_zh: 启动电磁炉，锅内加油预热
steps.content_en: Start the induction cooker, add oil to the pot and preheat it

steps.content_zh: 放入蒜末炒香
steps.content_en: Add minced garlic and saute until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 放入辣椒酱翻炒均匀
steps.content_en: Add chili sauce and stir-fry evenly

steps.content_zh: 加入水、盐、鸡精、糖、白醋，烧开
steps.content_en: Add water, salt, chicken essence, sugar, white vinegar and bring to a boil

steps.content_zh: 放入金针菇和土豆粉煮沸后捞出至碗内
steps.content_en: Add enoki mushrooms and potato powder, bring to a boil and remove into a bowl

steps.content_zh: 放入肥牛煮熟后捞出，放入碗中
steps.content_en: Add the fat beef and cook it, take it out and put it in a bowl

steps.content_zh: 倒入汤汁，撒上辣椒圈
美味的酸汤肥牛就完成啦
steps.content_en: Delicious fat beef in sour soup is ready

description_zh: 汤味鲜美，色泽诱人，炖好的牛肉入口酥烂，鲜香可口，融化每日的奔波疲惫
description_en: The soup is delicious and the color is attractive. The stewed beef is crispy and delicious, melting away the fatigue of daily running.
tips_zh: 时间允许的情况下，提前腌制的牛肉可以放入冰箱8小时，再烹饪，口味最佳哦
tips_en: If time permits, the beef marinated in advance can be placed in the refrigerator for 8 hours before cooking for the best taste.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 牛肉切块，西芹、洋葱、胡萝卜切块备用
锅内加适量油预热
steps.content_en: Add appropriate amount of oil to the pot and preheat

steps.content_zh: 放入牛肉煸炒上色，取出备用
steps.content_en: Add beef and stir-fry until browned, take out and set aside

steps.content_zh: 放入大蒜及各种蔬菜，炒香
steps.content_en: Add garlic and various vegetables and stir-fry until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 加入番茄酱、黑胡椒、迷迭香炒匀
steps.content_en: Add tomato paste, black pepper, and rosemary and stir well

steps.content_zh: 倒入红酒和清水，放入牛肉
steps.content_en: Pour in red wine and water, add beef

steps.content_zh: 盖上锅盖，开始炖煮
steps.content_en: Cover the pot and start simmering

steps.content_zh: 加入盐和糖，收汁
steps.content_en: Add salt and sugar to reduce juice

steps.content_zh: 红酒炖牛肉完成
steps.content_en: Red wine beef stew completed

description_zh: 意面配上经典肉酱，口口香浓，最适合你中国胃的西餐体验
tips_zh: 番茄罐头味道会更浓郁一些，家里有宝宝的可以把罐头换成番茄
tips_en: Canned tomatoes have a stronger flavor. If you have babies at home, you can replace canned tomatoes with tomatoes.

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 洋葱、 胡萝卜、和西芹、切小丁，大蒜切末备用
启动电磁炉，汤锅加半锅水，水开后加少量盐
steps.content_en: Start the induction cooker, fill the soup pot with half a pot of water, and add a small amount of salt after the water boils.

steps.content_zh: 放入意面煮至没有硬芯，捞出意面，加入橄榄油拌匀
steps.content_en: Add the pasta and cook until there is no hard core, remove the pasta, add olive oil and mix well

steps.content_zh: 炒锅加橄榄油预热
steps.content_en: Preheat wok with olive oil

steps.content_zh: 放入洋葱和大蒜，炒出香味
steps.content_en: Add onions and garlic and stir-fry until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 放入牛肉末和胡萝卜 西芹丁，炒至变色
steps.content_en: Add minced beef, diced carrots and celery, stir-fry until color changes

steps.content_zh: 放入番茄酱，炒至番茄酱融化
steps.content_en: Add tomato paste and stir-fry until tomato paste melts

steps.content_zh: 加入红酒、干酪碎、盐、糖、黑胡椒调味
steps.content_en: Add red wine, grated cheese, salt, sugar, and black pepper to taste

steps.content_zh: 放入意面翻炒均匀
steps.content_en: Add the pasta and stir-fry evenly

steps.content_zh: 出锅后再撒上些西芹沫 干酪碎，就可以享用啦
steps.content_en: After it's out of the pan, sprinkle some celery foam and grated cheese, and you're ready to enjoy.

description_zh: 一锅西班牙海鲜饭总是令人感觉，丰盛有美好食材，营养丰富，色彩诱人。真的满足所有的感官享受
tips_zh: 可以根据自己的喜好替换食材，但藏红花是做不可或缺的，少了它就少了灵魂。最后的成品尽量不要有汤汁，能有一层锅巴就最理想了

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 蒜切成蒜蓉，洋葱和红甜椒切成细丁，西红柿去皮切丁，欧芹洗净切碎，备用
steps.content_en: Chop the garlic into minced garlic, cut the onion and red bell pepper into fine dices, peel and dice the tomatoes, wash and chop the parsley and set aside.

steps.content_zh: 青口撤掉系带，刷洗干净。鱿鱼去掉内脏和软骨切段。大虾开背 去虾线。扇贝用小刀挖出备用 处理好的海鲜沥干水备用
高汤用一个小锅烧到热而不沸待用
steps.content_en: Heat the stock in a small pot until it is hot but not boiling. Set aside

steps.content_zh: 平底锅内放油预热
steps.content_en: Preheat oil in pan

steps.content_zh: 下洋葱蒜蓉和欧芹碎翻炒出香味
steps.content_en: Add onion, garlic and parsley and stir-fry until fragrant

steps.content_zh: 下番茄和甜椒炒2分钟至番茄出汁，甜椒略软
steps.content_en: Add the tomatoes and bell pepper and sauté for 2 minutes until the tomatoes release their juices and the bell pepper is slightly soft.

steps.content_zh: 下烟熏红粉椒玉米 大米和藏红花继续翻炒
steps.content_en: Add the smoked paprika corn and continue to stir-fry the rice and saffron

steps.content_zh: 倒入白葡萄酒和切片的西班牙辣肠
steps.content_en: Pour in white wine and sliced chorizo

steps.content_zh: 等酒气挥发掉后倒入高汤，汤要完全侵没米，加适量盐和黑胡椒调味
steps.content_en: After the alcohol evaporates, pour in the soup. The soup should completely cover the rice. Add appropriate amount of salt and black pepper to taste.

steps.content_zh: 不要翻动，至汤汁大部分被米粒吸收掉
将所有海鲜均匀铺在饭上，并往下轻轻按压至半埋在饭中
steps.content_en: Spread all the seafood evenly on the rice and press it down gently until it is half buried in the rice.

steps.content_zh: 再均匀的把青豆撒上去，继续煮
steps.content_en: Sprinkle the green beans evenly and continue cooking

steps.content_zh: 将海鲜翻面1-2次保证受热均匀，直至海鲜全部煮熟
steps.content_en: Turn the seafood over 1-2 times to ensure even heating until the seafood is fully cooked.

steps.content_zh: 待海鲜变色后 关火撒上欧芹摆上柠檬即可
steps.content_en: After the seafood changes color, turn off the heat and sprinkle with parsley and lemon.

description_zh: 将牛排两面煎至焦黄，外脆里嫩，口感极佳
description_en: Fry the steak on both sides until browned, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
tips_zh: 牛排建议2cm以内

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 先将洗净的蔬菜改刀
steps.content_en: Cut the washed vegetables first

steps.content_zh: 将牛排取出，吸干表面血水
steps.content_en: Take out the steak and drain the blood on the surface

steps.content_zh: 将牛排用棉线固定两圈
steps.content_en: Secure the steak twice with cotton thread

steps.content_zh: 表面撒海盐、黑胡椒
抹玉米油，将牛排翻面，注意将两面抹匀
启动电磁炉,预热1分钟
steps.content_en: Start the induction cooker and preheat for 1 minute

steps.content_zh: 放入牛排，煎制1分钟
steps.content_en: Add steak and cook for 1 minute

steps.content_zh: 翻面，继续煎制1分钟
steps.content_en: Turn over and continue frying for 1 minute

steps.content_zh: 再次翻面，放入黄油融化后，放入大蒜、香叶、迷迭香、百里香
steps.content_en: Flip again and add the butter, garlic, bay leaves, rosemary and thyme.

steps.content_zh: 将黄油、香料在牛排上抹匀，牛排出炉
steps.content_en: Spread the butter and spices evenly on the steak and take it out of the oven

steps.content_zh: 将蘑菇类入锅，煎制约2分钟
steps.content_en: Add the mushrooms to the pan and fry for about 2 minutes

steps.content_zh: 翻面并放入所有蔬菜
steps.content_en: Flip and add all vegetables

steps.content_zh: 撒盐和黑胡椒,出锅装盘
steps.content_en: Sprinkle salt and black pepper, remove from pan and serve

steps.content_zh: 开始享用吧
steps.content_en: Start enjoying

description_zh: 地道的意大利口味!
tips_zh: 煮意面时加入橄榄油和海盐会让面条更Q弹爽滑!

steps.content_zh: 准备好食材原料
steps.content_en: Prepare ingredients

steps.content_zh: 打开包装,取出所有配料
锅内加1L水煮沸
steps.content_en: Add 1L water to the pot and bring to boil

steps.content_zh: 放入意面,加入海盐和橄榄油
steps.content_en: Add pasta, sea salt and olive oil

steps.content_zh: 盖上盖子,煮熟
steps.content_en: Cover and cook

steps.content_zh: 盛出意面,控干水份
steps.content_en: Take out the pasta and control the moisture

steps.content_zh: 倒掉过内的水,放入煮好的意面,加入酱料翻炒均匀
steps.content_en: Pour off the water inside, add the cooked pasta, add the sauce and stir-fry evenly

steps.content_zh: 完成后根据个人口味加入其它配料即可
开始享用吧
steps.content_en: Start enjoying
